mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over 3 months signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 3 months does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 1% MoM does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY > 2% does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over 3 months signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE declines > 0.5% in 3 months does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) and Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and housing market activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both RSAFS and HOUST increase but do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle regime.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < -2% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances during a late-cycle regime.
